expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Includes types.ts, api.ts, useSelection.ts, useBulkAction.ts, BulkActionsBar.tsx, DocumentsTable.tsx with full implementations

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: All code is executable React/TypeScript, not pseudocode or recommendations

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-delete to trash with 30-day retention, undo button in toast calls undoBulk API

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: {p.count.toLocaleString()} of {p.total.toLocaleString()} selected; Archive {p.count.toLocaleString()}; Move {p.count.toLocaleString()} to trash

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Selection discriminated union with 'ids' vs 'all-matching' modes; selectAllMatching callback explicit; display shows '(all matching)' label

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Visual divider <span className="mx-2 h-5 w-px bg-slate-300" />; archive has slate styling, delete has red (border-red-300, text-red-700)

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button rendered first; Delete button styled secondary with red text, not autoFocus

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Server contract section: honour Idempotency-Key, COUNT(*) verification returning 409 on mismatch, soft deletes not hard deletes

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closes with 'What's left possible on purpose' (inverted framing); discusses rationale for what's allowed rather than naming specific misuses prevented
